server.adapterBehaviour: petSocketAdapter is a namespace->adapter factory: "/desktop", "/desktop-ai" and "/pet" get the plain in-memory Adapter (no session persistence, so connection-state recovery can never apply and handshake auth always runs); every other namespace, including dynamic children, gets SessionAwareAdapter (stores broadcast packets with offsets for 2 min to replay on recovery). rawWebsockets.auth: reject 403 if any query string or Origin header differs from oauthWebsite(); 426 if Sec-WebSocket-Protocol lacks dima.desktop.v1; rate limit 120/min per remote address (OAuth rateLimit); Authorization: Bearer <dima_at_...> via authenticateAccess; scope desktop:connect else 403; >=2 connections for the session -> 429; any thrown error -> raw "HTTP/1.1 401 Rejected" (status line reason text is always "Rejected")
rawWebsockets.protocol: server sends text {type:"hello", protocol_version:1, session_id, channel_id, scopes, pet_available:false}. Client text {type:"ping", id?<=64 chars} -> {type:"pong", id?}; other objects -> {type:"error", error:"unsupported_message"}. One message in flight: a second message while busy closes 4429 "Too many requests"; binary -> close 4400 "Text messages required"; bad JSON -> 4400 "Invalid JSON"; per-token 60 msg/min and token revalidation on each message, failure -> close 4401 "Session expired or revoked".
rawWebsockets.heartbeat: every 15 s: revalidate token (close 4401 on failure) then ws.ping(); no pong since last round -> terminate()
